sanskrit_verse:
एतानि सततं पश्येन् नमस्येदर्चयेच्च तान् ।
प्रदक्षिणं च कुर्वीत तथा ह्यायुर्न हीयते ॥
transliteration: etāni satataṃ paśyen namasyed arcayec ca tān | pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta tathā hy āyur na hīyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must always behold the divine forms, offer obeisance and worship Them, and perform circumambulation; by doing so, life force is preserved and not diminished.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in continuous divine vision and alignment
Causation flows from sustained consciousness connection
Capacity-based responsibility arises through daily ritual devotion
Restoration logic operates via rhythmic repetition of sacred acts
Consciousness alignment is secured through embodied reverence
executable_legal_axioms: IF citizen performs daily darshan, THEN life-energy preservation is recorded in karmic ledger
IF worship is omitted for three consecutive days, THEN initiate automated spiritual wellness check-in
IF pradakshina count < 108 in lunar cycle, THEN assign consciousness restoration module
IF namaskara frequency declines by 50%, THEN deploy dharma realignment protocol
IF divine gaze (darshan) is maintained >90% time, THEN grant dharmic integrity certification
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, the threshold of spiritual responsibility is determined by consistency of devotional acts. The court recognizes that constitutional authority derives from alignment with eternal forms, not punitive enforcement. Hierarchy of dharma-responsibility is calibrated by frequency of circumambulatory practice and depth of reverential engagement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causal chain of vitality preservation begins with uninterrupted darshan. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfoldment: seeing → saluting → worshipping → circling → sustaining life-force. Proportional responsibility aligns with regularity of these acts. Non-punitive reality rule confirms no penalty accrues—only natural consequence of energetic depletion when ritual rhythm is broken.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Automated Darshan Reminder System triggers visual alerts at sunrise
Namaskar Completion Tracker initiates gentle vibrational correction upon missed cycles
Pradakshina Count Monitor assigns guided circumambulation modules
Worship Sequence Reintegrator restores devotional capacity through personalized mantric alignment
Life Force Stabilizer Protocol activates upon detection of declining pranic coherence
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows from divine sight and sacred motion. No punishment inheres—only restoration through repetition. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, and alignment with eternal forms sustains all life.
